ShortDescription.Value: Copy & paste props — select, move, rotate, blueprint and stamp groups of props

Publish.LongDescription:
## Copaste A copy & paste tool for props — select groups of props, copy them, and stamp them anywhere with preserved layout, rotation and height.
## Features - **Click & marquee selection** — click props or drag a camera-aligned box; live highlight while dragging - **Copy & paste with preview** — the copied group follows your mouse as a ghost; click to place, repeat to stamp - **Move** — drag a selected prop to move the whole selection - **Group rotation** — hold right mouse button and drag, or use the panel buttons - **Height controls** — raise/lower (PgUp/PgDn), snap to ground (End), match another prop's height (Home) - **Type filter** — press T to only marquee-select props of one type - **Undo** — Ctrl+Z reverts move, rotate, height, delete and paste (32 steps) - **Blueprints** — save prop groups to disk and reuse them in any city or save - **Anarchy-style pasting** — ignores overlap errors while pasting (toggleable); integrates with the Anarchy mod to keep pasted props visible - **Toolbar button + panel** — clickable buttons for every action, with tooltips - All hotkeys rebindable, English and Serbian localization
## Usage Activate with **Ctrl+Shift+C** or the toolbar button. Click or drag-select props, **Ctrl+C** to copy, **Ctrl+V** to paste, click to place. Quick right-click steps back.
